title: Hero Journey Modpack |Intelligento's version|
description: The mods I use on Hero Journey
body:
- # Description
This is a select mods that I use durring Hero Journey Club missions

 This version include visiual improvements, performance improvements, adn just some gimicy stuff I like to have.

 ## Signed Paintings:

 Put any image on a sign.
 I find it best works using /paintings:upload file

 ## Building tools
 The modpack includes axiom which the server doesn't support. I reccomend creating a singleplayer world and converting to a schematic for litematica and rebuilding your build on missions.

 ## Vanilla Tweaks Downloader
 Vanilla tweaks is freindly additions to improve adn fix the in game textures.
 This modpack adds a downloader for these packs
 
 ## Extra Info
 
 The modpack comes equiped with an FPS metor and battery metor for laptops 
 - (Modpage says  batery display only works on windows)

 The Hero Journey Server IP is not added by defalt in order to protect the server from hackers, etc. You can go to their website for more info on Hero Journey herojourney.club

 - This modpack is not affiliated with hero journey club. If they want this project taken down then I will take it down
